tweets.text:
Watch this video…it’s one of the best history lessons on why immigration enforcement is playing out exactly as it is right now.

Janet Napolitano, Obama’s DHS Secretary, openly described their policy: catch people near the border within about 100-120 miles, prioritize criminals and security threats, and let everyone else settle in deeper into the country. That wasn’t an accident, it was the deliberate system.

They even cooked the books to earn Obama the “Deporter in Chief” title, reclassifying a ton of quick border turnarounds as formal removals to inflate the stats, while interior enforcement actually dropped sharply over his terms.

Look at who’s running DHS today: they came up through that exact system. No wonder @RealTomHoman and @CBPCommissioner are falling back on what they know. That’s why we’re not getting the mass deportations voters demanded.

Whoever sidelined @StephenM blocked what the American people voted for. 

The old incentives are still baked in, and the swamp protects itself through quiet institutional memory…
